# FDG8084

> DO ensure that `ToString` has no observable side effects.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.9.3 Object.ToString.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: observable side effects need to know what the methods ToString calls do.

## From the book

One reason for this is that `ToString` is called by debuggers during debugging, and such side effects can make debugging difficult.
